body:
Hi @JonnyTurnerUK,

You want to use instantsearch.js in a context where the user has to submit a form and be redirected to another webpage?

I am unsure why would you need instantsearch.js for then, since it was built for instant page updates? Maybe I am missing some context here.

The best way would be for you to give us access to some live environement demonstrating the issue.

Thanks
